high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the user "kendall.era." The post shows two individuals dancing outdoors at night. The setting appears to be a rustic or natural environment with trees and hanging moss in the background. There are also some lit candles placed on the ground, adding a warm ambiance to the scene. The person on the left is wearing a white, loose-fitting dress that is open at the front, revealing a bit of midriff. They have their hair styled back and are wearing high-heeled shoes.
